newsitem.title: HUNGARY: RESEARCH ALERT - ABN-AMRO keeps MOL "sell".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ABN-AMRO keeps MOL "sell".

text.p: ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett maintained the "sell" rating for Hungary's oil and gas company MOL Rt shares as higher gas import prices led to first quarter results below expectations.
"The disappointing improvement (of one percent) in the gross margin was due to the unexpected increase in the imported gas price," Budapest-based analyst Tommy Erdei said in a company update.
However, he did not revise earlier full-year forecasts.
"We feel it likely that MOL will receive an additional gas price increase on top of the quarterly devaluation adjustment to make up for the unexpected rise in gas prices," he said.
In the first quarter of 1997, MOL posted a consolidated IAS net profit of 12.7 billion forints on total sales of 172.8 billion forints.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, MOL shares closed at 3,400 forints on Monday while on the SEAQ MOL was marked at $18.25 at the 0814 GMT against Friday's close of $17.95.
